blocks.task_summary: Show that y = x + 50 cot theta using the tangent ratio from the right triangle formed by the boats' positions.
method_path: rearrange to y = x + 50 cot theta

evidence.basis: 50/tan theta = y - x OR cot theta = (y-x)/50 -> y = x + 50 cot theta [A1] [AG]; Note: y-x may be identified as a length on a diagram, and not written explicitly.

blocks.task_summary: Find the speed of boat A at time T given y - x = 10 m, dy/dt = 2 dx/dt, and dtheta/dt = -0.1 rad/s.
method_path: differentiate y = x + 50 cot theta wrt t to obtain dy/dt = dx/dt - 50 csc^2 theta dtheta/dt
simplify to dx/dt = -50 csc^2 theta dtheta/dt
use y - x = 10 to find cot theta = 1/5
substitute dtheta/dt = -0.1 and evaluate dx/dt = 5.2 m/s

evidence.basis: attempt to differentiate with respect to t (M1); dy/dt = dx/dt - 50 cosec^2 theta dtheta/dt [A1]
attempt to set speed of B equal to double the speed of A (M1); dx/dt = -50 cosec^2 theta dtheta/dt [A1]
cot theta = 1/5 OR theta = arctan 5 = 1.373... = 78.69... degrees [A1]; Note: This A1 can be awarded independently of previous marks.
cosec^2 theta = 1 + (1/5)^2 = 26/25; speed of boat A is 5.2 (m/s) [A1]
